provenance.title: VBA God Module
provenance.metric: patterns[name === "VBA God Module"].files — analyzed files where isCode !== false && functions.length > 20 (index.html:1414 detectPatterns `vbaGodFiles`). `VBA God Module` is `God Object` (> 15) at a higher ceiling over the same raw-text parser count, so this change targets <= 15 per sibling to avoid minting a God Object regression. `functions` is the headless parser count and `isCode` gates files absent from codeExts — notably the `.mts` oracle, `.json` fixture and `.md` record, none of which can ever be a reduction source.
provenance.filesNote: `files` is the analyzer's own `summary.totalFiles` for the snapshot. Only its ordering matters here: `after.files > before.files` proves the drop did not come from deleting files. `.mts` is not in `codeExts`/`textExts`, so the shared mirror and this issue's oracle add no parsed file.
provenance.baseCountNote: the issue was filed with 44 files at analyzedAt 1791738325602 against the then-main. The immutable base below (origin/main after #2001–#2005) reports 19 flagged files: the earlier refactors already cleared the Go/TS set. Acceptance is the drop on the delivered branch, not the filed number.
provenance.afterTipNote: the after snapshot is db16ddbb, the code-tree commit of this branch (the Python split, the shared `test/fixtures/function-count-mirror.mts` and the #2004 migration to it). The artifacts that follow it — this fixture, the per-sibling oracle, the replay block and the reference doc (`.json`/`.mts`/`.md`, never scored) plus comment-only docstring corrections in the six split `.py` modules — add no `def` or `class` line, so the delivered tree re-measures 17 flagged files, the same flagged set as `git archive db16ddbb`.
provenance.deferredNote: the 17 files below are still flagged on the delivered tree. Both removals are measured on the same analyzer as the split, so `before.vbaGodModuleCount === reducedBy.length + Σ deferred files`.

tradeoffs.vbaGodModule: 19 -> 17 flagged files (-2). Both split modules carried 21 parser declarations (one class line, the shared `setUp`/`tearDown`/helper block and the scenario tests); the class contract moved to `_bases.py` and whole `def test_*` methods moved verbatim, so every original and every sibling lands <= 15 — under the `> 20` ceiling and under the `> 15` God Object ceiling.
tradeoffs.godObject: 25 -> 23 flagged files: the expected co-benefit. `VBA God Module` is a strict subset of `God Object`, so a split that only brought a sibling under 20 could mint a God Object regression; targeting <= 15 prevents it. No sibling is itself flagged.
tradeoffs.longFile: unchanged (16 both sides): no file crossed the `> 500` line ceiling, and the two new siblings are far below it.
tradeoffs.functions: 3552 -> 3558 parsed declarations; the delivered tree also gains the `.py` modules the split landed (`totalFiles` 922 -> 927). No test was added, removed or renamed: `Σ test methods` is 16 (adapter) + 13 (registry) on both sides, asserted by the oracle.
tradeoffs.approach: the two 21-declaration modules were split by ecosystem/cache family with the shared harness extracted into a non-test `_bases.py`; whole test methods move verbatim, so `python3 test/dependency-existence-check.test.py` still runs 62 tests and the production module `scripts/dependency-existence-check.py` is untouched.
tradeoffs.notDone: the 16 `.rs` files and `server.py` stay flagged and are recorded as deferred with the reason they need a boundary this change does not own.

reducedByLater.reason: #2031 moved server.py's `/api/repos/*` routes into `handler_api.py` (16 -> 13 functions, so it leaves this metric's > 20 set too). It stops flagging without a #2006 follow-up, so it moves here instead of leaving the ledger.

deferred.reason: no Rust toolchain in the pipeline image — `which cargo/rustc` is empty, there is no Docker in-gate and no workflow compiles `embedded/docker/ui` (its builder image needs `rust:1.99`), so a split under that tree could not be compiled or tested before landing (#2002–#2005 precedent)
